verificationPolicy.semanticPromotionAuthority: Project owner or explicitly authorized maintainer

project.name: SC2 Master Coach
project.primaryPurpose: Provide local, evidence-bounded StarCraft II replay intelligence and decision coaching without claiming access to unreported game state.
project.primaryUser: A StarCraft II player seeking structured practice, replay review, and low-cognitive-load coaching.
project.economicBuyer: The individual player is the current buyer hypothesis; validation is UNVERIFIED.
project.stage: Local-first product beta; operational adoption and commercialization are UNVERIFIED.
project.deploymentTarget: Unsigned per-user Windows desktop application with a loopback-only Flask service and embedded web UI.

goals.name: Evidence-bounded player improvement
goals.description: A player can move from local evidence to one understandable, actionable practice decision without fabricated certainty.
goals.technicalSuccess: Replay and manual-report inputs produce bounded local outputs while preserving authority and privacy contracts.
goals.userSuccess: A player understands what to do next and why.
goals.operationalSuccess: The packaged Windows application completes the journey on a clean installation without developer intervention.
goals.commercialSuccess: Paying players repeatedly use the workflow and report a measurable improvement outcome; currently UNVERIFIED.

goals.name: Truthful live coaching
goals.description: The live surface asks for battlefield evidence, presents one decision at a time, and never implies process-level game observation.

goals.name: Operationally supportable Windows release
goals.description: A reproducible build, install, launch, replay, voice, and update path has current external receipts and a safe rollback.

journeys.name: Local replay to bounded practice decision
steps: Trigger: player launches the Windows or local application
Action: import a local replay or install the explicitly synthetic demo
State Change: a content-addressed local case is persisted
Authority / Evidence: replay parser output, normalized fact envelope, observation proxies, case manifest, patch and matchup metadata
Next State: review observed facts, derived local signals, withheld judgments, and open provisional practice
Outcome: one bounded practice focus without fabricated master comparison

journeys.name: Manual battlefield report to live coaching decision
steps: Trigger: player deploys a curated operation
Action: synchronize the timer and report observed battlefield evidence
State Change: Strategic OS updates Intel and selects CONTINUE, MODIFY, HOLD, or ABORT
Authority / Evidence: player report plus current policy and deterministic rules
Next State: Combat HUD shows one question, one action, and one reason
Outcome: player acts while uncertainty remains explicit

risks.name: Product-center ambiguity
risks.description: README release framing centers the Combat HUD while executable routing centers Master Intel.

risks.name: Static tests can overstate operational readiness
risks.description: Many tests inspect source contracts; they do not prove a clean Windows install, real replay capture, microphone behavior, or user acceptance.

risks.name: Patch knowledge can become stale
risks.description: Strategy and model behavior is pinned to StarCraft II 5.0.16b and requires explicit reconciliation after patch changes.

risks.name: Unsigned Windows distribution friction
risks.description: The documented zero-cost build remains unsigned and may trigger SmartScreen warnings.

blockers.summary: No current clean-Windows, real-replay end-to-end acceptance receipt is present.
blockers.evidence: Repository tests and workflow definitions exist; external Windows runtime evidence was not inspected.
blockers.resolutionCondition: A clean Windows installation imports a real supported replay, persists the case, renders the bounded debrief, exercises capture/voice fallbacks, and records reproducible artifacts and human acceptance.

blockers.summary: Provenance-backed replay-to-master comparison is not implemented.
blockers.evidence: A tested normalized local fact envelope and compatibility fingerprint now exist, but the comparison route deliberately withholds calculation because no compatible reference calculation and real-replay fixture proof exist.
blockers.resolutionCondition: A compatibility-gated calculation uses provenance-backed reference fingerprints to produce evidence-linked deltas from real replay fixtures without inventing identity or causality.

blockers.summary: Strategy benchmarks and coaching outcomes lack expert and player validation.
blockers.evidence: The live checkpoint UI labels derived guidance as pending expert review; decision-context reconstruction withholds strategic safety without matchup policy; no external review or outcome record is stored.
blockers.resolutionCondition: Named expert review and bounded player trials validate or revise the current-patch guidance with recorded methodology and results.

blockers.summary: Deployment, active usage, retention, outcome, and revenue remain UNVERIFIED.
blockers.evidence: Local tags and release automation are not provider receipts, telemetry, customer acceptance, or transactions.
blockers.resolutionCondition: Current provider receipts plus consented usage, retention, outcome, and transaction evidence are reconciled into this ledger.

blockers.summary: Primary product journey authority is inconsistent across current documentation and executable routing.
blockers.evidence: app.py serves Master Intel at / while README release framing calls the Combat HUD the product center.
blockers.resolutionCondition: The product owner confirms the primary journey and README, route behavior, release positioning, and NEXT proof event are reconciled to that decision.

proofEvents.name: Clean Windows real-replay coaching loop
proofEvents.whyItMatters: It is the smallest event that crosses source, packaging, real replay, persistence, fallback, UX, and human-acceptance boundaries.
acceptanceCriteria: Install and launch without developer tools.
Import a real replay and persist one content-addressed case.
Show patch, matchup, observed evidence, uncertainty, and one provisional practice focus.
Exercise actual frame capture or record the explicit unavailable fallback.
Exercise actual microphone recognition or record the explicit manual fallback.
Human tester confirms the next action and evidence boundary are understandable.
